book.name: HECHOS
book.title: Jesús' mitya kuinda kenueramula tyee dekeñuba Los Hechos de los Apóstoles

content: Pedro Juanba, dedeelaa rukunu ura' mandirela.
Ma malu Pedro Juanba kepenusha pen ura insha aa eleshasha jintsula, juntsa uranaa Diosba kuinda kenu urañu' mitya.

Tsenñu junu elesha vinu juukapasha main dedeelaa nakayamu chumi, yanu malumere aa eleshasha taji' chuchungaala “Naraa” mumu tinu juukapasha, tsenmalaa eleshasha vimu chachillanu lushi paki pakikenutsu.
Tsenñu juntsa ruku Pedronu bain, Juannu bain aa eleshasha vindetsu katatu, yalanu lushi pa'mi.
Tsenñu Pedro Juanba yanu keetu: Lalanu ke'laakika, timi Pedro.
Tsenñu juntsa ruku, yanu tyeeba kunaaba tsandilaa tyatu, yalanu ke'laadimi.
Tsenñu Pedro tsandimi: Naa ne ti lushi juuba tajtuyu, tsaaren ñu' mitya in pudengura kekaanu tsuyu. Nazaretsha chumu Jesucristo' mitya ñu mangujpa' nede, timi.
Tsandimin Pedro ya' urandyaapasha kake' kujtekemi; tsenmalan ya' neepa bain, naa nekunbele bain ura' demandiyaiñu,
dedeelaa nakayamu ruku kujpa' uidimin nedundaimi, tsai' bene yaiba aa eleshasha vitu, sundyanchin Diosnu yuj urave ti' yansai neneimi.
Tsenñu kumuinchi chachilla Diosnu yuj urave ti' neneintsu katatu,
pure' wapanai' keenbashiintsula entsaa puiñu dekata' jeetyatu, matyu juntsa rukaa aa eleshasha “Naraa” mumu puu juukapasha lushi paken chumuñuba demangueengatu.
Aa eleshasha Pedro' pañu palaa
Juntsa ura' mandimu ruku Pedronu bain, naa Juannu bain vela' mijindyumi. Kumuinchi chachillaya pure' wapanaa deju' yala' puinsha “Salomónchi” tinu ya faadinu panbee shilisha dejiila.

Tsenñu Pedro chachilla dewa'na katatu tsandimi: Israel' chulla, ¿nenñu deiyu keenbashintsula? ¿Nenñu dekiyu, matyu lalaren tsanguenuu jutu, tsa jutyu' bain, lala yuj ura ruku deju', entsa rukunu ura' demanñu keran tsanguintsula?
Naa Abrahamchi bain, naa Isaacchi bain, naa Jacobchi bain, tsenmin lala' yumaa apalachi bain jumu Diosya,

yachi taawasha kemu Jesúsnu tsamantsaa bale tiwaave, matyu ñulla ñulla' bale rukula' tyaapanu kuwadekishu juntsa rukunu, tsenmin ñullaya yanu demutyatyu', naamika Pilatoya mandyaikenu tyañuren demandyaikikaatyushu juntsa rukunu.
Tsejtu ñullaya juntsa ruku Dioschin juu jumunu, tsenmin Dios naakesa tyañuba tsanguemu ruku jumunaa demandyaikikaatyu' cha' tu'mu rukunaa livee ke' mandyaikikaamuwa deeve.
Tsanguitaa ñulla naa-uwanuba ura' chumishtikenuu tiremu rukunaa detu'kaave, tsenñu bain Diosya yanu mangujteñu lala entsa kera deeyu.
Entsa dedeelaa ju' nenu jutyuu ruku ura' mandiñu ñulla katare' mijadeishu juntsaya, Jesúsnu kerangue' mityaa tsaive, tsenñaa Jesús entsangue' ura' mandireve ñulla' ajuusha.
Tsaaren uwain, judío naatalala, ñulla' bale rukulaba tyee kenduba mijtutaa tsangue' Jesúsnu deka' tu'muwa deeñuba miyu.
Tsaaren Diosya, entsangue' puiwaataa kumuinchi ya' mitya pamulanu naatikare'ba juntsaa depuiwaave: matyu yachi Mi'ke' Kayamu ruku uwain peyanu tsuve ti' pakaamuwa' mitya.
Tsa' mitya ñulla, veta' pensa demangue' Diosnu meenguidei tsa-i' ñulla' ujcha manbitsalanu.
Tsenmalaa Bale Ruku ñullanu tiba jutyu lekakaanu malu eenu tsuve, tsenmin Jesúsnu yachi Mi'ke' Kayamunu eenu tsuve, ya yumalaren ñuichi kuwanuu jumuwaañu' mitya.
Tsaaren challaya Jesús selusha chunuuya juve, Dios kumuinchi tiba deechu' demangue' kasa demandirenbera, matyu yachin juu ya' mitya pamu rukulanu yumaa tinbunu naati pakaamuwaañuba tsaitu.
Moisés lala' tinbu aa-apalanu entsandimuwaave: Bale Ruku lala' Dios ñulla' bululanun main iya juuñuu Diosa' mitya pamu ruku faawaanu tsuve, tsenmala ya naatiñuba meenguide.
Mun ya' palaanu meedityulaya
Israel chachilla' kejtsapala kala' kelaranu tsuve,
timuwaave Moisés.
Tsenmin kumuinchi Diosa' mitya pamu rukula bain, Samuelbi jimin, bene pamula bain entsa malutala tyee inuuñuba juntsanun papatimuwa deeve.

Dios ya' mitya pamulanu tyee kunu tsuyu ti' pakaamuwaañu bain entsa ñullanaa tsaa depuinu tsuve. Tsenmin Dios lala' tinbu aa-apa Abrahamnu naati' veta' veta' tsanguedaa timuwaañuba juntsa bain ñullanaa tsaa puinu tsuve. Entsandimuwaave: Ñunu sera' jimula' mityaren kumuinchi paandela Dioschi ura' inu detsuve,
timuwaave.

Tsa' mitya Dios yachi taawasha kemu, ya' nanu mangujtetu, ñulla' jungaa ajke' eeve, tsanguitaa ñullanu Dioschi ura' iwaanu, tsenmalaa ñulla main main ñulla' firu' ken mitya veta' pensa demangue' Diosnu keenguenudetsu.
